newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan central bank sets year-end news conference.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan central bank sets year-end news conference.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Thursday it would hold a year-end news conference on December 31 but declined to disclose the topic.
The news conference will be held at 4 p.m. (0800 GMT), a bank official said by telephone.
Local media speculated the central bank may use the event to announce a lowering of its 9-14 percent M2 money supply growth target zone.

On Thursday, Taiwan's top economic policymaker said the government would soon lower its target zone for growth of M2 money supply to 8-13 percent from 9-14 percent in a concession to economic "reality".
"All related officials have agreed to lower the M2 target zone to 8-13 percent," Chi Schive, vice-chairman of the cabinet's Council for Economic Planning and Development, told Reuters by telephone.
"It's only a matter of timing when it will be done. We'll leave this to the central bank to decide," Schive said.
